headline: Nevish Line Erupts Anew as Expanse and Linn Mercy Still Burn
war_summary: The Nevish Line, quiet at our last writing, has burst back into flame: forty-three flag movements in a day, fifteen inside two hours, Blackcoat Way, Blinding Stones and Princefal the busiest grounds, and the map there now reads five Warden posts, two Colonial and one in ruin. The Weathered Expanse burns on — fifty-two flag movements, Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Necropolis again hardest contested — its stands now three Warden, two Colonial, four demolished. Linn Mercy's ledger climbs apace about Lathair and Outwich Ranch, casualty rates steepening sharply on both sides; Marban Hollow still seesaws at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall; Mooring County's Wind Hills traded flags through the evening, though all twelve posts remain Warden-held. Kuura Strand saw six of its seven flag movements fall upon Faden Point, and the Colonial flag holds all six bases there. Callahans Passage raises no flag, yet its daily casualty lists are the war's heaviest. Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf stir in the ledgers once more. It is day 727; thirty-four victory towns must fall to decide this war, and no victor is yet declared.
